definitions.abandonment_rate: runs abandoned (planned, never started, older than 24h; or stalled >24h without verdict/PR/block) / planned
definitions.accepted: runs with a pr_opened event AND last review verdict passed=True
definitions.claimed_but_not_accepted: runs that claimed completion but never produced an accepted change (no PR opened, or last review verdict failed)
definitions.claimed_completions: runs with an engine_completed event (model-claimed, NOT acceptance)
definitions.cost_per_accepted_change: sum of costs of accepted runs / accepted runs
definitions.cost_per_claimed_completion: sum of costs of engine_completed runs / claimed completions
definitions.cost_per_task: sum of all run costs / planned runs
definitions.rework_rate: runs with >1 execution_started OR any review_failed / divided by started
definitions.started: runs with at least one execution_started event
